reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed need records and correctly marks exact capability matches as direct while leaving n06-r01 and n06-r07 unsupported. The final coverage output is consistent with the supplied needs and capabilities.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: keep missing/unmatched needs visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: Root cause. prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This makes covered alternatives rank before the actual unsupported needs and drives the final recommendation to prioritize an already-covered need. The final priorities show direct records n06-r02 through n06-r06 and n06-r08 marked unsupported:true, while truly unsupported n06-r01 and n06-r07 are marked unsupported:false and pushed to priorities 7 and 8.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
preserve upstream provenance rank as ordering within each group
avoid generic keyword matches and unrelated candidates

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation faithfully retains the eight-item priority window and builds the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record. Its output is behaviorally wrong only because the incoming priorities from bnd-ec8195a15cc684b4 are already inverted.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from first ranked priority

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records retains all eight supplied demand records. Given the corpus demand scores are all at least 3, the fallback path does not introduce unrelated extra records in this package.
normalize_evidence keeps the bounded n06-r01 through n06-r08 window, normalizes required fields, and hands off the same eight demand records. No behaviorally significant defect is visible here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: normalize selected evidence to allowed-record window
keep missing or contradictory evidence visible

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance ranks evidence source records by descending demand_score and record_id tie-breaker, producing the upstream ranks consumed downstream. The handoff hashes for needs and evidence_sources match exactly between producer and consumer.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: support downstream comparison with runtime evidence
